# nest-cloudflare-turnstile

> Cloudflare Turnstile captcha guard for NestJS 10, 11 and 12. It verifies Turnstile tokens with Cloudflare's siteverify API before route handlers run, on Express or Fastify, including GraphQL resolvers and WebSocket gateways.

Install with `npm install nest-cloudflare-turnstile` (Node.js 20 or later). Register `TurnstileModule.forRoot({ secretKey })`, then put `@TurnstileCaptcha()` on a route or controller. The guard reads the token from the `cf-turnstile-response` body field or header. The secret `1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA` is Cloudflare's always-passes test key and must not be used in production.

## Docs

- [Home](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/): overview and a quick example
- [Get started](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/get-started.html): install, register the module, protect a route and send the token from the browser
- [Frontend frameworks](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/frontend.html): sending the token from React, Next.js, Vue and Angular
- [Options](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/turnstile-options.html): every module option with its type and default
- [Error handling](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/error-handling.html): responses for missing or invalid tokens, custom exceptions and onError
- [Testing](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/testing.html): skipIf, stubbing the service and Cloudflare's test keys
- [Advanced usage](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/advanced.html): per-route actions, a global guard, several widgets, GraphQL, WebSockets, Fastify and proxies
- [Upgrading from 0.0.x](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/migration.html): requirements and behavior changes in 1.0
- [Migrating from reCAPTCHA](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/from-google-recaptcha.html): option, decorator and error code mapping from @nestlab/google-recaptcha
- [Live demo](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/demo/): the Turnstile widget with Cloudflare's test site keys, the token it returns and the guard code that verifies it

## Blog

- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/): guides to Turnstile, captcha providers and server-side verification
- [hCaptcha, reCAPTCHA and Turnstile compared](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/hcaptcha-vs-recaptcha-vs-turnstile.html): hCaptcha vs reCAPTCHA vs Cloudflare Turnstile: how each widget works, token lifetime, siteverify requests, free tiers and what changes on your server.
- [reCAPTCHA alternatives worth a look](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/recaptcha-alternatives.html): reCAPTCHA alternatives compared: Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha, ALTCHA and Friendly Captcha, how each one verifies visitors, and their free plans.
- [How Cloudflare Turnstile tells people from bots](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/what-is-cloudflare-turnstile.html): What Cloudflare Turnstile is, how its widget turns a background challenge into a token, and how your server verifies that token with the siteverify API.
- [Turnstile error codes, from 600010 to timeout-or-duplicate](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/turnstile-error-codes.html): What Cloudflare Turnstile error 600010 means, the other client-side codes such as 110200 and 300 errors, siteverify error codes and the fixes Cloudflare lists.
- [Turnstile or reCAPTCHA: what differs for your app](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/cloudflare-turnstile-vs-recaptcha.html): Cloudflare Turnstile vs Google reCAPTCHA: challenges, scores, token lifetime, free tiers and what the switch changes in your backend code and your tests.
- [Setting up the Turnstile widget in the page](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/turnstile-widget-options.html): Every Cloudflare Turnstile widget option: size, theme, appearance, execution, language, retry, action and cdata, with data attributes and render() names.
- [A Turnstile tutorial with Cloudflare's test keys](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/turnstile-test-keys.html): Use Cloudflare Turnstile test keys to build and test a form locally: site keys that pass, fail or force a challenge, test secrets and the NestJS test stub.
- [Captcha checks belong on the server](https://projects.halit.org/nest-cloudflare-turnstile/blog/verify-captcha-server-side.html): Why a captcha widget alone protects nothing, what a server-side check must verify, and how a NestJS guard verifies Turnstile tokens on every request.
